integrity: The kernel, moment identities and limiting coefficients are analytically proved and supported by independent symbolic/numerical consistency checks; independent external assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to two-point disk interpolation bodies only and along their diagonal; no off-diagonal metric or higher-node analogue. Priority risk persists concerning older Pick-body geometry manuscripts not obtained in full.
title: Exact Bergman anisotropy and logarithmic collapse on two-node Pick bodies
